result.title: Statistical Vignettes on the Grokking Phenomenon
result.summary: In this work, we study grokking in a simple, analytically tractable setting whose rich phenomenology allows us to disentangle the effects of initialization, signal strength, weight decay, sample size, and input dimension. These factors can produce superficially similar learning curves through distinct mechanisms, complicating their interpretation. Our analysis distinguishes early fitting through nuisance features, core feature learning, and delayed generalization. We identify sharp conditions under which grokking provably occurs and derive analytic asymptotic expressions for the lengths of the generalization plateaus. Our results also characterize regimes of early generalization and failure to reach a prescribed test accuracy target. We show that the interpolation edge constitutes a distinct dynamical regime, where vanishing spectral gaps separate core learning from generalization, helping clarify the role of proximity to interpolation in existing accounts of grokking. The resulting picture is analogous to fast and slow phases in chemical kinetics and suggests that the lazy-to-rich transition discussed in the literature may reflect a similar separation of dynamical time scales. Our theoretical results are faithfully supported by extensive experiments.

AI.brief_summary: 该文在一个可解析处理的简单设定下研究 grokking 现象，把早期拟合、核心特征学习与延迟泛化解耦，给出 grokking 发生的锐利条件、泛化平台期的渐近长度，并指出接近插值边界是一种独立动力学区制，认为 lazy-to-rich 转变可能对应不同时间尺度的分离。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「捷径/ nuisance 特征先学、核心特征后学、泛化延迟」与快慢时间尺度分离的框架，可能为理解 LVR 中视觉旁路、潜在推理状态何时才被真正使用以及训练中推理能力涌现的时序提供概念类比，但与原论文场景差异较大，具体可迁移性需核查。
